summary.text: Kandie Smith is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 5 since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives and as mayor of Greenville.

paragraphs.text: Kandie Smith earned a B.S. in sociology from Charleston Southern University in 1991, and her career experience includes working as a consultant, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Smith said she was the first Black woman to serve as mayor of Greenville and had spent nearly a decade on the Greenville City Council representing District 1.
She represented North Carolina House District 8 from 2019 to 2023, according to Ballotpedia, and assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural and Economic Resources; Education/Higher Education; Transportation; and State and Local Government.
In the 2022 survey, she named housing affordability and public education funding among her key messages.
